decision.reasoning_trace: In this shopping session, I evaluated a range of speakers from high-end stationary units to budget-friendly portables. The JBL Charge 4 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_013) is a strong contender but its status as a 'renewed' item makes me cautious about the long-term battery health. The Sony SRS-RA3000 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_144) and Ultimate Ears Megablast (prod_bluetooth_speakers_003) offer premium sound but are priced quite high, and the UE model has noted integration issues with Alexa. The Altec Lansing (prod_bluetooth_speakers_045) and Raymate (prod_bluetooth_speakers_153) are excellent for their low price points, but I was ideally looking for a new, high-performance mid-range speaker. Finding no perfect fit that balances brand new condition, high rating, and competitive mid-range pricing, I have decided not to make a purchase today.
